lines: Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastana bhi bana
Deewana jo banaya to main deewana bhi bana
couplets.en: I swayed and raised the cry of ecstasy, for you had made me mad with love.

lines: Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastana bhi bana
couplets.en: I swayed and let the cry of ecstasy rise.

lines: Deewana jo banaya to main deewana bhi bana
Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastana bhi bana
couplets.en: When you made me mad with love, I swayed and raised the cry of ecstasy.

lines: Nigaah-e-yaar ne hi mujh ko deewana banaya
Raunaq-e-duniya aur gham se begaana banaya
couplets.en: The beloved's glance drove me mad and put the world's glitter and grief beyond my care.

lines: Sar-e-mehfil jo ik tamaasha lagaya
Meri nazron mein jo khud ko basaya
couplets.en: You made a spectacle before the gathering and took up dwelling in my eyes.

lines: Dar-e-yaar pe jis ne Bulleh Shah ko nachaya
Bulleh Shah ko nachaya, Bulleh Shah ko nachaya
couplets.en: It was you who set Bulleh Shah dancing at the beloved's door.

lines: Jab maanga deedaar to Koh-e-Toor jalaya
Koh-e-Toor jalaya, Koh-e-Toor jalaya
couplets.en: When a glimpse was asked of you, you set Mount Sinai ablaze.

lines: Jo dar maanga to dar paaya
Jo sar maanga to kham paaya
couplets.en: I asked for a door and found one, and when a head was asked of me, mine was already bowed.

lines: Kahin Sarmad, kahin Mansoor
Haq pe hoon to faazil hoon
couplets.en: Here Sarmad, there Mansoor, and in the truth I find my worth.

lines: Hans ke main jaan de doon
Laahaasil ka woh haasil hoon
couplets.en: I would give my life with a smile, for I am the fruit of what cannot be attained.

lines: Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastana bhi bana
Deewana jo banaya to main deewana bhi bana
couplets.en: I swayed and raised the cry of ecstasy, for you had made me mad with love.

lines: Jhoom liya, naara-e-mastana bhi bana
couplets.en: I swayed and let the cry of ecstasy rise.

lines: Ki jo hasrat ke mujh ko tamaasha na bana
Sar-e-baazaar jo nachaya to ab hosh mein na la
couplets.en: I wished to be spared the spectacle, but having made me dance in the marketplace, leave me in my trance.

lines: Saaghar ki aarzu hai, saaghar ki aarzu hai
Haan, saaghar ki aarzu hai, ab tu paimaana na thama
couplets.en: I long for the brimming goblet, so hand me no measured cup.

lines: Hauz-e-Kausar pe bula, mujhe be-hisaab pila
Deewana jo banaya to main deewana bhi bana
couplets.en: Call me to the pool of Kawthar and let me drink without measure, for you have made me mad with love.

lines: Maula, Maula
Maula, Maula
